paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better
caption: : LLaMA-2-7B
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the change in informativeness across different values of an unspecified x-axis variable, ranging from 0 to 4, for two conditions: “w.o. extension” and “extension,” both using the LLaMA-2-7B model. The y-axis, labeled “Informativeness,” is scaled linearly and ranges from 0.920 to 0.970. The “w.o. extension” condition is represented by a blue dashed line with circular markers, starting at an informativeness of 0.970 when x=0 and decreasing to 0.920 when x=4. The “extension” condition is represented by an orange solid line with triangular markers, also starting at 0.970 when x=0 and decreasing to 0.920 when x=4. Both lines show a consistent downward trend across the x-axis range, with the “w.o. extension” line consistently positioned slightly above the “extension” line at each corresponding x-value.
